verses.original: Οἱ κύριοι παρέχεσθε τοῖς δούλοις τὸ δίκαιον καὶ τὴν ἰσότητα εἰδότες ὅτι ὑμεῖς καὶ ἔχετε Κύριον ἐν οὐρανῷ
verses.transliteration: Hoi kyrioi parechesthe tois doulois to dikaion kai tēn isotēta eidotes hoti hymeis kai echete Kyrion en ouranō
verses.literal: - Masters supply [your] slaves with what [is] right and - fair since you know that you also have a Master in heaven

verses.original: προσκαρτερεῖτε Τῇ προσευχῇ γρηγοροῦντες ἐν εὐχαριστίᾳ ἐν αὐτῇ
verses.transliteration: proskartereite Tē proseuchē grēgorountes en eucharistia en autē
verses.literal: Devote yourselves to prayer being watchful [and] thankful - -

verses.original: ἅμα προσευχόμενοι καὶ περὶ ἡμῶν ἵνα ὁ Θεὸς ἀνοίξῃ ἡμῖν θύραν τοῦ λόγου λαλῆσαι τὸ μυστήριον τοῦ Χριστοῦ δι’ ὃ καὶ δέδεμαι
verses.transliteration: hama proseuchomenoi kai peri hēmōn hina ho Theos anoixē hēmin thyran tou logou lalēsai to mystērion tou Christou di’ ho kai dedemai
verses.literal: as you pray also for us that - God may open to us a door for the word so that we may proclaim the mystery - of Christ for which - I am in chains

verses.original: ἵνα φανερώσω αὐτὸ ὡς με δεῖ λαλῆσαι
verses.transliteration: hina phanerōsō auto hōs me dei lalēsai
verses.literal: [Pray] that I may declare it clearly . . . as I should . . .

verses.original: περιπατεῖτε Ἐν σοφίᾳ πρὸς τοὺς ἔξω ἐξαγοραζόμενοι τὸν καιρὸν
verses.transliteration: peripateite En sophia pros tous exō exagorazomenoi ton kairon
verses.literal: Act vvv wisely toward - outsiders redeeming the time

verses.original: ὑμῶν ὁ λόγος πάντοτε ἐν χάριτι ἠρτυμένος ἅλατι εἰδέναι πῶς δεῖ ὑμᾶς ἀποκρίνεσθαι ἑκάστῳ ἑνὶ
verses.transliteration: hymōn ho logos pantote en chariti ērtymenos halati eidenai pōs dei hymas apokrinesthai hekastō heni
verses.literal: [Let] your - speech always [be] . . . gracious seasoned with salt so that you may know how vvv vvv to answer everyone . . .

verses.original: Τυχικὸς γνωρίσει ὑμῖν πάντα Τὰ κατ’ ἐμὲ ὁ ἀγαπητὸς ἀδελφὸς καὶ πιστὸς διάκονος καὶ σύνδουλος ἐν Κυρίῳ
verses.transliteration: Tychikos gnōrisei hymin panta Ta kat’ eme ho agapētos adelphos kai pistos diakonos kai syndoulos en Kyriō
verses.literal: Tychicus will tell you all the news about me [He is] a beloved brother - a faithful minister and a fellow servant in [the] Lord

verses.original: ἔπεμψα ὃν πρὸς ὑμᾶς εἰς αὐτὸ τοῦτο ἵνα γνῶτε τὰ περὶ ἡμῶν καὶ παρακαλέσῃ ὑμῶν τὰς καρδίας
verses.transliteration: epempsa hon pros hymas eis auto touto hina gnōte ta peri hēmōn kai parakalesē hymōn tas kardias
verses.literal: I have sent him to you for this very purpose that you may know - about us and that he may encourage your - hearts

verses.original: σὺν Ὀνησίμῳ τῷ πιστῷ καὶ ἀγαπητῷ ἀδελφῷ ὅς ἐστιν ἐξ ὑμῶν γνωρίσουσιν ὑμῖν πάντα τὰ ὧδε
verses.transliteration: syn Onēsimō tō pistō kai agapētō adelphō hos estin ex hymōn gnōrisousin hymin panta ta hōde
verses.literal: With him [I am sending] Onesimus [our] faithful and beloved brother who is [one] of you They will tell you {about} everything - here

verses.original: μου ὁ συναιχμάλωτός Ἀρίσταρχος Ἀσπάζεται ὑμᾶς καὶ Μᾶρκος ὁ ἀνεψιὸς Βαρνάβα ἐλάβετε ἐντολάς περὶ οὗ ἐὰν ἔλθῃ πρὸς ὑμᾶς δέξασθε αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: mou ho synaichmalōtos Aristarchos Aspazetai hymas kai Markos ho anepsios Barnaba elabete entolas peri hou ean elthē pros hymas dexasthe auton
verses.literal: My - fellow prisoner Aristarchus sends you greetings . . . as does Mark the cousin of Barnabas You have [already] received instructions about [him] If he comes to you welcome him

verses.original: Ἰησοῦς ὁ λεγόμενος Ἰοῦστος καὶ οὗτοι ὄντες μόνοι περιτομῆς ἐκ οἱ συνεργοὶ εἰς τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ Θεοῦ οἵτινες ἐγενήθησάν παρηγορία μοι
verses.transliteration: Iēsous ho legomenos Ioustos kai houtoi ontes monoi peritomēs ek hoi synergoi eis tēn basileian tou Theou hoitines egenēthēsan parēgoria moi
verses.literal: Jesus - who is called Justus also [sends greetings] These are [the] only Jews among [my] fellow workers for the kingdom - of God [and] they have been a comfort to me

verses.original: Ἐπαφρᾶς ὁ ἐξ ὑμῶν δοῦλος Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ Ἀσπάζεται ὑμᾶς πάντοτε ἀγωνιζόμενος ἐν ταῖς προσευχαῖς ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν ἵνα σταθῆτε τέλειοι καὶ πεπληροφορημένοι ἐν παντὶ θελήματι τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: Epaphras ho ex hymōn doulos Christou Iēsou Aspazetai hymas pantote agōnizomenos en tais proseuchais hyper hymōn hina stathēte teleioi kai peplērophorēmenoi en panti thelēmati tou Theou
verses.literal: Epaphras who [is] [one] of you [and] a servant of Christ Jesus sends you greetings . . . [He is] always wrestling in - prayer for you so that you may stand mature and fully assured in [the] full will - of God

verses.original: γὰρ μαρτυρῶ αὐτῷ ὅτι ἔχει πολὺν πόνον ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν καὶ τῶν ἐν Λαοδικείᾳ καὶ τῶν ἐν Ἱερα‿ πόλει
verses.transliteration: gar martyrō autō hoti echei polyn ponon hyper hymōn kai tōn en Laodikeia kai tōn en Hiera polei
verses.literal: For I testify about him that he goes to great pains for you and for those at Laodicea and - - Hierapolis . . .

verses.original: Λουκᾶς ὁ ὁ ἀγαπητὸς ἰατρὸς καὶ Δημᾶς Ἀσπάζεται ὑμᾶς
verses.transliteration: Loukas ho ho agapētos iatros kai Dēmas Aspazetai hymas
verses.literal: Luke the - beloved physician and Demas send you greetings . . .

verses.original: Ἀσπάσασθε τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς ἐν Λαοδικείᾳ καὶ Νύμφαν καὶ τὴν ἐκκλησίαν κατ’ αὐτῆς οἶκον
verses.transliteration: Aspasasthe tous adelphous en Laodikeia kai Nymphan kai tēn ekklēsian kat’ autēs oikon
verses.literal: Greet the brothers in Laodicea as well as Nympha and the church [that meets] at her house

verses.original: Καὶ ὅταν ἡ ἐπιστολή ἀναγνωσθῇ παρ’ ὑμῖν ποιήσατε ἵνα ἀναγνωσθῇ καὶ ἐν τῇ ἐκκλησίᾳ Λαοδικέων καὶ ἵνα ὑμεῖς καὶ ἀναγνῶτε τὴν ἐκ Λαοδικείας
verses.transliteration: Kai hotan hē epistolē anagnōsthē par’ hymin poiēsate hina anagnōsthē kai en tē ekklēsia Laodikeōn kai hina hymeis kai anagnōte tēn ek Laodikeias
verses.literal: - After [this] letter has been read among you make sure that it is also read . . . in the church of [the] Laodiceans and that you in turn read the [letter] from Laodicea

verses.original: Καὶ εἴπατε Ἀρχίππῳ Βλέπε ἵνα πληροῖς αὐτὴν τὴν διακονίαν ἣν παρέλαβες ἐν Κυρίῳ
verses.transliteration: Kai eipate Archippō Blepe hina plērois autēn tēn diakonian hēn parelabes en Kyriō
verses.literal: - Tell Archippus See to it that you complete - the ministry - you have received in [the] Lord

verses.original: Ὁ ἀσπασμὸς τῇ ἐμῇ χειρὶ Παύλου Μνημονεύετέ μου τῶν δεσμῶν Ἡ χάρις μεθ’ ὑμῶν
verses.transliteration: Ho aspasmos tē emē cheiri Paulou Mnēmoneuete mou tōn desmōn Hē charis meth’ hymōn
verses.literal: This greeting [is in my] own hand Paul Remember my - chains - Grace [be] with you
